description.en: Agenzia Grafica Milano is a Milan web agency (Corso Buenos Aires 45) offering a hybrid accessibility service combining automated scanning with manual screen-reader testing to remediate sites against WCAG 2.2 AA and prepare accessibility declarations for the European Accessibility Act.

sourceRefs.label: quotes 'I nostri sviluppatori navigano il sito usando screen reader (come NVDA o VoiceOver) per capire l'esperienza reale', cites WCAG 2.2 Level AA and the EAA (effective 28 June 2025), lists address 'Corso Buenos Aires 45, 20124 Milano', and footer '© Il team di Agenzia Grafica Milano 2013 - 2026'; live fetch 2026-08-13

description.en: Accessibilità Online, run by Astrelia Srl in San Benedetto del Tronto, offers a free preliminary manual accessibility audit of a site's main pages followed by paid remediation guidance and monitoring against WCAG and EAA requirements, explicitly positioning itself against overlay widgets as a full solution.

sourceRefs.label: quotes audit method 'Durante l'audit preliminare, vengono prese in considerazione alcune della pagine principale e valutati diversi aspetti, tra cui la struttura della pagina, la navigazione, i colori utilizzati, la leggibilità dei testi, l'accessibilità delle immagini', notes 'L'audit preliminare è GRATUITO', and lists 'Astrelia Srl, Via Mattei, 1, San Benedetto del Tronto, 63074 (AP)'; live fetch 2026-08-13

description.en: TechMucho is an IT firm founded in 2013 by Ilyass Mouchafi offering full technical accessibility audits ('check-up del sito') that identify barriers against WCAG and the European Accessibility Act, effective in Italy since 28 June 2025.

sourceRefs.label: quotes 'offriamo audit tecnici completi. Sono veri check-up del sito. Identificano barriere e criticità' and 'Seguiamo normative WCAG e European Accessibility Act. Quest'ultimo è in vigore dal 28 giugno 2025'; live fetch 2026-08-13
quotes 'Il progetto nasce nel 2013, dal fondatore Ilyass Mouchafi'; live fetch 2026-08-13

description.en: Redmango is a Turin-based agency offering website accessibility testing against WCAG 2.1 and current European regulation, positioned as ongoing compliance support with annual follow-ups rather than a one-off check.

sourceRefs.label: quotes 'valutiamo il sito web secondo le linee guida WCAG 2.1 (Web Content Accessibility Guidelines)' and 'follow-up annuali e aggiornamenti costanti nel tempo, non soluzioni standard'; live fetch 2026-08-13

description.en: MTP is a Madrid-headquartered digital consultancy (with additional Spanish offices in Sevilla, Almeria and Alicante) offering digital-accessibility consulting, its own DInclusive accessibility certification, and training through MTP Academy, evaluated against WCAG and EN 301549.

sourceRefs.label: quotes 'Evaluamos y mejoramos tus productos según normativas internacionales como WCAG o EN 301549, entre otras' and lists 'Consultoría de Accesibilidad Digital', 'Certificación de accesibilidad digital Dinclusive' and 'MTP Academy'; live fetch 2026-08-13
quotes HQ address 'Calle de Santa Leonor 65, Edificio C, Planta 4, 28037 Madrid'; live fetch 2026-08-13

description.en: comAcesso, presented in January 2010 by Norberto Sousa and Ricardo Monteiro, is a Portuguese consultancy performing full manual-plus-automated audits of websites and digital products, accessibility consulting for web pages and apps, and accessibility training.

sourceRefs.label: quotes 'Prestamos consultoria em acessibilidade de páginas web, Apps e conteúdos digitais', 'Ministramos ações de formação em acessibilidade' and 'Realizamos a peritagem completa de um Site ou produto digital, que inclui testes automáticos e manuais'; live fetch 2026-08-13

quotes project 'apresentado em janeiro de 2010' and founders' backgrounds (Norberto Sousa ~10 years with assistive technologies, Ricardo Monteiro's accessibility/design postgraduate work); live fetch 2026-08-13
